MOTIF

Self-supervised transformer for cross-tissue gene expression prediction with conditional diffusion generative augmentation

Research Framing

We develop a self-supervised multi-omics transformer model that learns transferable regulatory representations across tissues and improves downstream gene expression prediction compared to task-specific baselines. A conditional generative component augments data and enhances model robustness. A conditional **diffusion model** generates tissue-specific synthetic ATAC + methylation profiles.
